purpose: Demonstrate a matched training-seed report on existing width experiments, distinguishing optimizer variation, chain resampling, and ensemble gain. This repeats a known recipe comparison and is not a new width discovery.
exposure: Both folds and these recipes were previously selected and inspected. No confirmation or selection-adjusted significance claim is permitted.
checkpoint_policy: Previously cached fixed epoch-3 parents followed by one head-only fine-tune; verify provenance from original scripts/logs before interpreting.
primary_readout: all three matched seed effects, sample SD across them, their mean, and conditional chain intervals; report ensemble separately
gate: methodology demonstration only, no candidate selection; no extra seed or fold search after results
stop: one bounded cached CPU run; cap 8 minutes and 8 GiB
